overview: The IIT Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) at IIT Bombay provide incubation support to technology-based startups, offering infrastructure, mentorship, and networking opportunities to foster innovation and entrepreneurship. The program aims to convert research and ideas into viable entrepreneurial ventures through structured support systems.
objectives: Provide infrastructure and mentorship to startups
Convert research activity into entrepreneurial ventures
eligibility: Technology-based startups and entrepreneurs seeking incubation support at IIT Bombay's Technology Business Incubator (TBI) are eligible to apply. Specific criteria may include innovation quotient, scalability, and alignment with IIT Bombay's focus areas.
benefits: Incubatees receive access to IIT Bombay's research infrastructure, mentorship from faculty and industry experts, networking opportunities, legal and IP support, seed funding assistance, and access to investor networks. The TBI also provides office space, laboratory facilities, and administrative support.
financial_support: The TBI facilitates access to seed funding, grants, and investment opportunities through its network of investors, venture capitalists, and government schemes. Specific financial support mechanisms include assistance in applying for government grants, angel investments, and venture capital funding, though direct quantum is not specified in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Visit the IIT Bombay TBI website or portal. 2. Review eligibility and program details. 3. Submit an online application with business plan, team details, and innovation description. 4. Undergo screening and evaluation by the TBI selection committee. 5. Attend interview or pitch session if shortlisted. 6. Receive incubation offer and complete onboarding formalities.
required_documents: Proof of concept or prototype details
IP details or patent filings (if any)
caveats: Incubation support is subject to availability of space and resources
Continued support depends on performance and milestones achieved
Equity or revenue-sharing may be applicable in some cases
Program duration is typically limited to a fixed period (e.g., 1-3 years)
